settings.name: Mark
settings.title: A dream come true
settings.body: I’m a West Ham fan and it was my dream to get this cup. The size and detail are spot on. I will treasure it.

settings.name: James T.
settings.title: Incredible detail for a 1:1 replica
settings.body: Ordered this as a surprise for my dad, a lifelong football fan. The size and finish are stunning, and engraving our family name on it made it really personal. It now has pride of place in his study.

settings.name: Daniel O.
settings.title: Exactly like the trophy on TV
settings.body: I was nervous ordering something this big online, but it arrived perfectly packed and looks identical to the cup I've seen lifted on TV. Communication throughout was excellent.

settings.hero_desc: A carefully detailed scale model of the Grand Mosque of Makkah - the Kaaba at its centre, surrounded by the courtyard, arcades and minarets. A profoundly meaningful centrepiece and gift, built with respect and precision.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your scale, finish, base and dedication plaque
settings.s1_body: We recreate the holiest sites of Islam as detailed scale models, built with care and respect. This model of Masjid al-Haram captures the Kaaba within its courtyard, the surrounding galleries and the soaring minarets. A deeply significant centrepiece for mosques, institutions and homes, and a profound gift for dignitaries, donors and loved ones.
settings.case_body: Commissioned as a Display in Saudi Railway, this model of the Grand Mosque carried real significance for its recipient - the sacred site recreated with care and presented as a keepsake to be treasured.
settings.case_quote: It moved everyone who saw it. A beautiful, respectful tribute to the holiest of places.
settings.prov_p: The Kaaba holds significant importance in the Islamic religion. Muslims around the world visit the Kaaba in Masjid Al Haram. About 1.7 million people visit Kaaba for pilgrimage.
